title: Capacitors: types, polarity, and uses

spans.text: A capacitor stores electrical charge briefly. Ceramic capacitors are usually non-polar; electrolytic capacitors have positive and negative leads.
A supply capacitor can reduce voltage changes. Never reverse a polarized capacitor or exceed its voltage rating.
